label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark leads U.S. Open
items.text: Wyndham Clark shot even par today to lead the U.S. Open at 6-under through 4 holes, three strokes ahead of Max McGreevy, Matt Fitzpatrick, and Dustin Johnson at 3-under.

items.headline: DeChambeau's 427-yard drive
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau hit a 427-yard tee shot on the par-4 12th at Shinnecock Hills, which caromed off the road close to the hole, helping him birdie and sit six shots behind the leader after round 1.

items.headline: McIlroy, Scheffler struggle opening day
items.text: Rory McIlroy and Scottie Scheffler faced tough first round conditions at the U.S. Open and are looking for improved outcomes on day two.
